assessment.nobel_worthiness: HPV virus-like-particle vaccines established a highly effective route to preventing infection-associated cancers, with exceptional worldwide public-health significance.
assessment.attribution: The three proposed laureates represent complementary central work on the viral antigens and their translation into the vaccine concept.
assessment.maturity: The preventive effect and real-world clinical importance have been demonstrated over many years.
uncertainties: The precise division of foundational versus translational credit across the broader vaccine-development effort requires careful review.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: GLP-1 physiology enabled a transformative therapeutic approach to diabetes and obesity with broad consequences for metabolic medicine.
assessment.attribution: Holst, Mojsov, and Drucker capture key physiological, molecular, and translational contributions, though the full chain includes substantial additional work.
assessment.maturity: The biological mechanism and therapeutic benefit are extensively established, including across large clinical populations.
uncertainties: Attribution between discovery of GLP-1, receptor biology, and drug development is unusually diffuse.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: CAR-T therapy created a new modality of living, genetically engineered cancer treatment and produced durable remissions in otherwise refractory disease.
assessment.attribution: The proposed trio covers foundational adoptive-cell therapy, engineered receptor design, and decisive clinical development.
assessment.maturity: Its clinical efficacy, limitations, and expanding therapeutic role have been tested over a substantial period.
uncertainties: The contribution of many investigators to CAR design, cell manufacture, and clinical implementation complicates a three-person allocation.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: BCR-ABL inhibition made molecularly targeted therapy a compelling clinical paradigm and profoundly changed chronic myeloid leukemia outcomes.
assessment.attribution: Druker, Lydon, and Sawyers represent drug development, clinical proof, and mechanistic development of targeted leukemia treatment.
assessment.maturity: The therapeutic principle has long-standing clinical validation and influence far beyond CML.
uncertainties: The discovery rests on an extended lineage of work on the Philadelphia chromosome and BCR-ABL biology.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Antisense correction of SMN2 splicing provided a mechanistically precise treatment for spinal muscular atrophy and validated RNA splicing as a therapeutic target.
assessment.attribution: Krainer and Bennett offer a focused pairing of fundamental splicing insight and antisense therapeutic development.
assessment.maturity: Clinical benefit has been demonstrated and the strategy has materially altered care for a severe inherited disease.
uncertainties: Further assessment is needed of the relative contribution of the wider SMA genetics and clinical-development communities.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: High-frequency deep brain stimulation has given many people with Parkinson's disease major and durable relief of disabling motor symptoms.
assessment.attribution: Benabid is a clear leading figure in establishing the high-frequency stimulation approach.
assessment.maturity: The treatment has undergone decades of clinical use, optimization, and follow-up.
uncertainties: Its place as a prize-recognized discovery rather than an outstanding therapeutic innovation merits comparison with broader mechanistic breakthroughs.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Fetal cell-free DNA analysis enabled noninvasive prenatal screening and changed prenatal molecular diagnostics worldwide.
assessment.attribution: Lo is strongly and directly associated with the central discovery and its clinical translation.
assessment.maturity: The method is widely implemented, clinically validated, and has demonstrated sustained medical impact.
uncertainties: The appropriate boundary between the foundational biological finding and subsequent commercial screening platforms requires attention.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optogenetics made causal, cell-type-specific interrogation of neural circuits possible and reshaped experimental neuroscience.
assessment.attribution: The proposed names combine the microbial opsin foundation with the development of optogenetics as a practical neurobiological method.
assessment.maturity: The approach is broadly reproduced and has generated extensive mechanistic insight across neuroscience.
uncertainties: Credit is distributed across multiple indispensable contributors, including investigators listed but not proposed here.
